facts.fact: La Tribune Afrique reports that the National Assembly adopted bill 04/2026 creating the CNRM on 3 March 2026, which charges it with overseeing transparency of AI-generated content; no promulgation or entry into force is stated.

systems.system: Conseil national de régulation des médias (CNRM)

SEN.note: No government use of AI is stated.
No sectoral AI tool is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
